answers.reason: The full professor holds an academic office and rank, but orientation week planning is not restricted by higher office or specific regulations mentioned for this role.
As a faculty member holding a chair and leading a research group, the full professor participates in internal faculty matters.
The senate decides on statutes and strategy, involving high-ranking office holders under the university-wide plan.
The full professor is a member of the faculty and participates in faculty affairs.
Budget allocation is part of the university-wide plan involving office holders of higher rank.
Full professors are involved in appointments as part of the university-wide academic structure.
Examination matters are handled by specific boards rather than general professorial duties.
Laboratory equipment procurement is specific to teaching laboratories and not part of general professorial duties.
Module revisions are handled within degree programmes and study commissions.
The study commission prepares changes to degree programmes and advises the faculty council, where professors participate.
